vehicle_records.//trigger: When the record is finalized, transmitted and FROZEN.
vehicle_records.//trigger_2: instant     first frame the vehicle is detected
vehicle_records.//trigger_3: zone_entry  vehicle enters the dwell zone
vehicle_records.//trigger_4: zone_exit   vehicle leaves the dwell zone  (DEFAULT)
vehicle_records.//trigger_6: zone_exit is the default because a plate needs several
vehicle_records.//trigger_7: agreeing frames to confirm. An earlier trigger commits the
vehicle_records.//trigger_8: record before the plate can resolve and sends the car as
vehicle_records.//trigger_9: plateless when it was about to be identified — a
vehicle_records.//trigger_10: self-inflicted miss that looks like a model failure.
vehicle_records.//conf: App-side floor on the SDK's car-detection confidence. 0.0 =
vehicle_records.//conf_2: trust the engine, which already gates at
vehicle_records.//fields: Which descriptive classifiers are EXPECTED to contribute.
vehicle_records.//fields_2: Declared rather than inferred, so a null field can be read
vehicle_records.//fields_3: as 'not enabled' instead of 'enabled but never produced a
vehicle_records.//fields_4: reading' — different facts with different fixes.
vehicle_records.//fields_5: make_model_enabled requires VMMR in the production config;
vehicle_records.//fields_6: measured at ~268ms/frame with LPCI+VBSR, which does NOT fit
vehicle_records.//fields_7: the 200ms budget at 5fps. Off until that is re-measured.
